info.title: start
info.description: Backend API for the AI Interview Preparation Platform powered by FastAPI and local Qwen 2.5 on Ollama.

502.description: Ollama returned an unexpected or error response

503.description: Ollama service is unreachable or timed out

get.description: Checks whether the Ollama server is reachable and whether the configured model is installed.

200.description: Database connection is operational and healthy

503.description: Database is unreachable or not configured

get.description: Checks whether the PostgreSQL database connection is operational without exposing credentials.
Returns the operational status and environment of the FastAPI backend.

502.description: Bad gateway or malformed response from AI model

503.description: Ollama service unavailable or timed out

post.description: Generates a tailored interview question with evaluation points and a follow-up question using the local Qwen 2.5 model via Ollama with guaranteed JSON structure.

502.description: Bad gateway or malformed response from AI model

503.description: Ollama service unavailable or timed out

post.description: Evaluates a candidate's answer against expected criteria using local Qwen 2.5 and returns structured feedback, strengths, improvements, and a rubric-aligned score.

post.summary: Generate Next Interview Question for Session

400.description: Invalid session state, question unanswered, or maximum questions reached

503.description: Ollama service unavailable or timed out

post.description: Generate and advance to the next interview question using Qwen 2.5 on Ollama.

post.summary: Submit and Evaluate Candidate Answer for Session

400.description: Invalid session state, question already answered, or session completed

503.description: Ollama service unavailable or timed out

post.description: Submit candidate answer for the active session question and evaluate it using Qwen 2.5 on Ollama.

post.summary: Complete Interview Session and Generate Summary

200.description: Session completed and summary generated successfully

post.description: Mark session as completed and calculate overall score, rubric rating, strengths, and improvement areas.

get.description: Retrieve full details, question history, and progress for an interview session.

post.description: Initialize a new interview session with configured role, level, difficulty, and total questions.

200.description: List of interview sessions retrieved successfully

get.description: Retrieve a paginated list of interview sessions ordered by most recent.
Returns a welcome message and links to API documentation.
